- **V1, placement**: the installer put every file in place and `node install.mjs verify` passes. Checked automatically for every agent by `scripts/test/installer.test.js` and `scripts/test/installer-e2e.test.js` on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- **V2, load check**: the agent's own CLI, run headlessly, lists the installed skill. ⚠️ means it was not run; the reason is below.
- **V3, behavior**: a person ran `evals/agent-smoke/` in that agent and recorded the result. This is a HUMAN GATE.
- **Supported** needs V1 and V3. **Installed, behavior unverified** means the files are in the place the agent's docs name, but nobody has yet watched the agent use them.
- Kind: `skill` copies the whole skill (Agent Skills format, `SKILL.md`); `block` adds a managed block to a shared file; `file` writes a managed rule file. Block and file kinds point the agent at the shared copy in `.frontend-craft/`.

### V2 results

- AGENTS.md (any agent that reads it): ⚠️ not run: AGENTS.md is a convention, not one agent; it is covered by the agents above that read it.
- Aider: ⚠️ not run: aider-chat could not be installed: current releases need Python 3.10 to 3.12 and the build environment has Python 3.13; aider also has no command that lists read files without a model.
- Amp: ⚠️ not run: re-tried 2026-10-19 with @sourcegraph/amp 0.0.1792368068-g91990d: `amp skill list` and `amp skill info frontend-craft` exist, but each prints "No API key found. Starting login flow...", a login URL and "paste your code here", then waits (stopped after 45 seconds); listing needs a signed-in Amp account.
- Augment (Auggie): ⚠️ not run: @augmentcode/auggie 0.36.0 installed, but it has no skill-listing command and --print stops with "No auth provided"; needs a sign-in.
- Claude Code: ✅ `claude -p "List the names of the skills available to you" --output-format json` with claude 2.1.300 on 2026-10-15: frontend-craft listed after a project-scope install; absent in an empty control project.
- Cline: ⚠️ not run: cline 3.0.71 installed, but `cline skill` only forwards to the separate `npx skills` CLI, which would not show what Cline itself loads; listing Cline's loaded skills needs a signed-in session.
- Codex CLI: ✅ `codex debug prompt-input` with @openai/codex 0.163.0 (codex-cli 0.163.0) on 2026-10-19: re-run 2026-10-19 (first pass 2026-10-15 on 0.162.1): the model-visible prompt lists frontend-craft with .agents/skills/frontend-craft/SKILL.md after a project-scope install (fresh HOME, no sign-in); absent in an empty control project.
- Continue: ⚠️ not run: @continuedev/cli 1.5.47 installed, but it has no rule-listing command; checking needs a signed-in -p session.
- GitHub Copilot: ✅ `copilot skill list` with @github/copilot 1.0.98 on 2026-10-15: frontend-craft listed under "Project skills" after a project-scope install (fresh HOME, no sign-in).
- Cursor: ⚠️ not run: the Cursor CLI is installed only by a shell script from cursor.com, not a package; it was not run.
- Gemini CLI: ✅ `gemini skills list` with @google/gemini-cli 0.64.0 on 2026-10-15: frontend-craft [Enabled] from ~/.agents/skills (user scope) and from .agents/skills in a trusted project folder; skipped in an untrusted folder.
- Goose: ⚠️ not run: Goose ships as a binary from a shell script or GitHub releases, not an npm package; it was not run.
- JetBrains Junie: ⚠️ not run: JetBrains Junie runs inside JetBrains IDEs; no headless CLI was available.
- Kilo Code: ✅ `kilo debug skill` with @kilocode/cli 7.8.8 on 2026-10-15: frontend-craft listed at .agents/skills/frontend-craft/SKILL.md after a project-scope install (fresh HOME, no sign-in); absent in an empty control project.
- opencode: ✅ `opencode debug skill` with opencode-ai 1.19.3 on 2026-10-19: re-run 2026-10-19 (first pass 2026-10-15 on 1.19.0): frontend-craft listed at .agents/skills/frontend-craft/SKILL.md after a project-scope install (fresh HOME, no sign-in); absent in an empty control project.
- Qwen Code: ⚠️ not run: re-tried 2026-10-19 with @qwen-code/qwen-code 0.25.2: it has no skill-listing command (`qwen --help` lists none; `qwen extensions list` and `--list-extensions` cover extensions, not .qwen/skills, and printed "No extensions installed."), and a headless prompt returns "No auth type is selected"; needs a configured model provider.
- Roo Code: ⚠️ not run: Roo Code is a VS Code extension with no headless CLI.
- Windsurf (Devin Desktop): ⚠️ not run: Windsurf (Devin Desktop) is a desktop app with no headless CLI.
- Zed: ⚠️ not run: Zed is a desktop editor with no headless skill-listing command.

### Caveats

- AGENTS.md (any agent that reads it): Not tied to one agent's docs; agents that also load skills do not need it.
- Aider: Aider does not load CONVENTIONS.md automatically: add "read: CONVENTIONS.md" to .aider.conf.yml (merge with any existing read list) or start aider with --read CONVENTIONS.md. The installer does not edit YAML.
- Amp: Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
- Amp: Amp has no project marker the installer can detect, so --agent auto never selects it.
- Augment (Auggie): Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
- Augment (Auggie): If Claude Code is installed too, this agent may also read .claude/skills/ and list the skill twice.
- Cline: If Claude Code is installed too, this agent may also read .claude/skills/ and list the skill twice.
- Codex CLI: Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
- Continue: Skills support and a file-based user location are not documented on the pages read, so user scope is not offered.
- GitHub Copilot: If Claude Code is installed too, this agent may also read .claude/skills/ and list the skill twice.
- Cursor: Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
- Cursor: If Claude Code is installed too, this agent may also read .claude/skills/ and list the skill twice.
- Gemini CLI: Gemini CLI skips project skills in folders it does not trust ("Skipping project agents due to untrusted folder"). Trust the project folder, or install with --scope user. Observed with gemini 0.64.0 on 2026-10-15.
- Goose: If Claude Code is installed too, this agent may also read .claude/skills/ and list the skill twice.
- JetBrains Junie: Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
- JetBrains Junie: Project skills load only in a trusted project.
- Kilo Code: Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
- opencode: If Claude Code is installed too, this agent may also read .claude/skills/ and list the skill twice.
- Windsurf (Devin Desktop): Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
- Zed: Project skills load only in a trusted worktree.

## Node

The CLI and scripts require Node 20 or newer. CI runs on Node 20 and 22.

## Project stacks

| Stack | Static checks (Tier 0) | Rendered checks (Tier 2) |
|---|---|---|
| any | contract validation, token contrast, `tokens build`, catalog search | |
| React, Next.js, Tailwind | all static rules | `craft shoot` on a running dev server or built HTML |
| Plain HTML and CSS | all static rules | `craft shoot --file` |
| Vue, Svelte, Astro | CSS-level rules and template markup rules | `craft shoot` on a running dev server |

Component conformance (`contracts/conformance/run.js`) was run against Radix Primitives and
React Aria Components; see `docs/evals/conformance-results.md`.
